definitions.short: Nimrah , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H5247. Nimrah נִמְרָה proper name, of a location place east of Jordan Num 32:3 (+ חֶשְׁבּוֺן דִּיבֹן, עֲטָרוֺת, , etc.), ᵐ5 Ναμβρα , A Αμβραμ , ᵐ5 L Μαμβραν . Perhaps = Tel Nimrîn , approximately 6 miles east of Jordan, nearly opposite Jericho, compare Buhl Geogr. 264. — compare נ ׳בֵּית (q. v.), also in Late Hebrew (compare נמרה proper name, masculine Sinaitic Inscriptions SACook 81 Lzb 323 ; meaning dubious; Nö ZMG xxix (1875), 437 thinks from spotted or striped appearance of ground; place of leopard also Gray Prop. Names 92 (on tribal names from leopard see RS K 201 also Sabean proper name אנמרם Levy-Os l.c., etc. ); We Heid:2, 82 thinks of clear water [compare following]).
